sources.title: Nishitetsu operator president describes current Fukuoka data-center operations
sources.publisher: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Nishitetsu Information System
sources.attribution: Impress / Cloud Watch; firsthand interview with Nishitetsu Information System
sources.summary: Nishitetsu Information System president 小水正人 describes operating about 250 racks across two floors, with about 80% occupancy in the external-customer area. The operator also serves its railway group and discusses improving air conditioning and operational automation. This is firsthand participant testimony in an August 3 interview publication; the interview date is undisclosed. GPU hosting and a possible second building remain under consideration, with no achieved expansion reported.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: 小水正人
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: Representative Director and President, Nishitetsu Information System Co., Ltd.
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: Nishitetsu Data Center, Fukuoka; article introduction names the facility and the interview describes its current two-floor operations.
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The president says the company currently operates a data center of about 250 racks on two floors, with approximately 80% occupancy in its external-customer area. (Paraphrase of the directly attributed response.)
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: 2026-08-03 is the visible article publication date and matching JSON-LD datePublished, used as the conservative publication-based current-operation observation. The actual interview day is not disclosed; no exact operating event or opening date is inferred.
firsthand_status_statement.review: The source remains labelled news. The selected statement is the named operator president’s direct firsthand response to a question about current data-center operations, not the reporter’s un-attributed characterization, a target, or aggregate portfolio capacity. His response and the named introduction refer to this one existing Fukuoka facility.

sources.title: Nishitetsu Data Center facility and service specifications
sources.summary: Nishitetsu Information System describes its Hakata facility as completed in February 2008, with a seismic-isolation structure, two incoming feeds from different substations, redundant UPS and air cooling, emergency generation and round-the-clock onsite operations. It offers fractional and full racks, colocation and managed monitoring. The February 2008 completion month is distinct from later external-service launch. The undated page does not establish a new status-observation day.

sources.title: BSI IS 87613 scope appendix names Nishitetsu colocation host building
sources.publisher: BSI Group Japan; certificate hosted by ICT Construction / Gyosei System Kyushu
sources.attribution: BSI Group Japan; certificate hosted by ICT Construction / Gyosei System Kyushu
sources.summary: Page 10 of the tenant-group certificate identifies Nishitetsu Data Center (Colocation) at Nishitetsu Chiyo-Kenchoguchi Building, 4-1-33 Chiyo, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka. The listed activities include operation and maintenance of internal systems and cloud infrastructure. The certificate shows latest revision October 16, 2025, effective October 31, 2025 and expiry October 30, 2028. This is a tenant certification scope and address bridge, not a newly issued whole-facility certification or a 2026 operating observation.

sources.title: Nishitetsu official listing for the Chiyo-Kenchoguchi host building
sources.summary: The property owner names Nishitetsu Chiyo-Kenchoguchi Building at 4-1-33 Chiyo, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka, beside Chiyo-Kenchoguchi station. It records a ten-storey reinforced-concrete office building completed in February 2008. The building is a mixed-use host; whole-building floor area and standard office specifications do not describe the data-center space.

sources.title: Nishitetsu corporate history records the 2014 data-center service opening
sources.summary: PDF page 28 (printed page 198) records the Nishitetsu Data Center opening on May 8, 2014. This is the historical service-opening entry; the operator separately gives February 2008 for building completion. Neither date is replaced by the August 2026 current-operation interview.

sources.summary: Selected named host-building place 西鉄千代県庁口ビル has coordinates 33.602851 latitude, 130.4143405 longitude. The marker locates the shared building that the tenant certificate names. It does not locate the individual data-center floors or establish a surveyed boundary or operational status.
